The figure is a grouped bar chart displaying the weekly reported cases of newly diagnosed individuals and the weekly media reported cases of COVID-19 in China. The horizontal axis represents time, with dates ranging from July 1, 2022, to September 26, 2022, labeled at approximately 7-day intervals. The left vertical axis represents the number of newly diagnosed individuals, scaled linearly from 0 to 1,800,000 in increments of 200,000. The right vertical axis represents the weekly media reported COVID-19 cases, scaled linearly from 0 to 6,000 in increments of 1,000. The chart consists of grouped bars for each week. Each group contains two bars: a teal bar representing the number of newly diagnosed individuals and a light blue bar representing the weekly media reported COVID-19 cases. The teal bars generally range in height from approximately 200,000 to 1,600,000, with variations across the time period. The light blue bars are considerably shorter, ranging from approximately 0 to 5,000. The bars are arranged chronologically, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar or group. A legend at the bottom of the chart identifies the teal bars as “该日全球确诊数量” (daily global confirmed cases) and the light blue bars as “有关covid-19新闻数量” (number of COVID-19 related news).
